description:
The aviation industry is in crisis and it's only getting worse as the war in Iran continues. Oil trade through the Strait of Hormuz remains uncertain. The continued US naval blockade means Iran has pledged to retaliate further against US forces. Disruption to fuel supply is likely to continue. Since the closure of the Strait, some airlines have reported pandemic-level losses. The price of jet fuel has climbed by 125 per cent since the start of the war in Iran and with prolonged restrictions on maritime traffic, there are growing concerns about the availability of jet fuel. 

#iran #trump #straitofhormuz #airtravel #travel 

Airlines and their customers are hoping for a permanent reopening of the Strait ahead of the busiest period.

So with systematic jet fuel shortages looming, will your flights take off this summer?
